entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi, David. I'm calling because I need to return an item. It's the new VeloBand Pulse monitor.
I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your account, could I please get your full name and order number?
Of course. My name is Sarah Miller, and the order number is... VF789012. I've been a VeloFit customer for a long time, I was really excited about this.

Thank you, Sarah. I see your order right here, delivered on December 15th. I appreciate your loyalty with VeloFit. So I can best assist you, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the band or more of a personal preference?

Oh, it's not broken or anything. It's... just not for me. To be honest, it was an impulse buy and after the holidays... well, I really needed this money back. I feel awful about it, but things are a bit tight.
I completely understand, things happen. Thank you for clarifying that for me. Let me just pull up the return policy information for that item. Please hold for one moment.

Alright, Sarah, thanks for your patience. I've checked our system, and our policy states that items can be returned within 90 days of delivery. Since you received this just 20 days ago, you are well within that window.
Oh, really? Are you sure? That's... that's such a relief. I was so worried I had missed the deadline.

Not at all. I am processing the return for you right now. I've just sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email we have on file. Simply place the VeloBand back in its original packaging, affix the label, and you can drop it off at any post office.
Wow. Thank you so much, David. You've been a huge help. This really takes a weight off my shoulders.

It's my pleasure to help. Once our warehouse receives the item, a full refund will be issued to your original form of payment within 3 to 5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
